description:
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Hub Oil Seal that repairs leaking seals in the Front Hubs.
It does BOTH SIDES.
What Will I Receive?
Qty 2 – Hub Oil Seal 09283-50002
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
